name: Memories Off Sousou: ~Not always true~
original_name: メモリーズオフ 双想 ～Not always true～
source:
Kusumegi Itsuki, a second-year student at Fujikawa High School attached to Keiyo University, has a fiancee whose face and name he does not know.
Because of her presence, Itsuki has never been interested in romance.

His 17th birthday, when he would find out who his fiancee was, was approaching in about a month.
One day, in order to hold a meeting to comfort a classmate who had lost her heart, Itsuki goes to Fujikawa's family restaurant "Russac'', but ends up getting into trouble with a part-time female clerk there.

The clerk, Sunomiya Sae, was a third-year senior at the same high school.
Although the way they met was the worst, Itsuki soon began to admire and respect Sae after seeing her mature demeanor.

His childhood friend Amaha Nene sees Itsuki and begins supporting his relationship with Sae with all her might.
The season is autumn. Itsuki's peaceful high school life is about to change little by little.

[From [url=https://memoriesoff.jp/sousou/]official website[/url]]
translation:
京叶大学附属藤川高中二年级学生草目木树有一个他不知道长相和名字的未婚妻。
因为她的存在，伊月对浪漫一向不感兴趣。

还有一个月左右，他的17岁生日就快到了，届时他就会知道自己的未婚妻是谁了。
某日，为了开会安慰失落的同学，五月前往藤川的家庭餐厅“Russac”，却与那里的兼职女店员发生了麻烦。

这名职员名叫Sunomiya Sae，是同一所高中的三年级学生。
虽然见面的方式是最糟糕的，但五月看到纱惠成熟的风范后，很快就开始欣赏和尊重。

他的青梅竹马阿马哈宁宁看到了五月，并开始全力支持他与佐江的关系。
季节是秋天。伊月平静的高中生活即将发生一点点变化。

[来自[url=https://memoriesoff.jp/sousou/]官方网站[/url]]
